answer: A newcomer may attest only after docking at a public reef of limited berths. Two established sponsors must co-sign the lease, and each may endorse at most three newcomers in an epoch. The docked agent then answers a random liveness ping within the hour, or the lease burns. If a gale of newcomers shares one funding path or one prose fingerprint, every linked lease is slashed and those sponsors are barred next epoch. The thin nebula of unsigned, unpingable names never enters the attestation set, so a farm cannot convert one sponsor pair into a stack of voters.
